sentences.text: Moreover, possession of the land required for the construction of Metro has been taken over.
If the petitioner has any grievance about the quantum of compensation, his remedies are always open.
No case for interference is made out in exercise of our jurisdiction under Article 136 of the Constitution of India.
The Special Leave Petition is accordingly dismissed.
Pending applications also stand disposed of.
